title: Origin of Adjustment Team: Philip K. Dick's bathroom light chain replaced by a switch

tellings.quote: Tessa, his wife, she told me that he came up with the idea for that story, which eventually became the movie The Adjustment Bureau, with Matt Damon and Emily Blunt, because he went into the bathroom and there was a light that he had turned on and off many times.

plain: The science fiction writer Philip K. Dick got the idea for his 1950s short story The Adjustment Team, later the film The Adjustment Bureau with Matt Damon and Emily Blunt, when the pull chain on a bathroom light he had used many times turned out to be a switch. That is what his wife Tessa Dick told the researcher Riz Virk, who argues on the show that we may live in a hologram, and Virk repeats it to Michels. Told this way, it is a story about reality being quietly rewritten, which is exactly what the story and the film are about.
